Evidence-based decision-making for adjuvant VBT in 47-year-old woman with Stage IA2 endometrial cancer (Grade 1, <50% myoinvasion, no LVSI) post-TAH-BSO. Include PORTEC evidence, risk stratification, arguments for/against, and brachytherapy approach if elected.

A 35-year-old woman named Aisha is 20 weeks pregnant and has been diagnosed with Stage IB2 cervical cancer. She and her husband desperately want to continue the pregnancy while receiving cancer treatment. The multidisciplinary team must balance fetal safety with maternal cancer treatment. Design a treatment approach that considers all aspects of this complex situation.
